IC1: Patients of familial cases of POF :
IC2: Female  subjects between 16 and 40 years [OR] or women  older than 40 years [AND] with a cessation of ovarian function before the age of 40 years [AND] with increased levels of FSH
IC3: Primary [OR] or secondary amenorrhea for more than three months with LH and FSH> 30mUI/ml
IC4: [NOT] No cases of fragile X syndrome [OR] in the family or blepharophimosis syndrome
IC5: At least two cases in the family
IC7: Patient signing the consent form for at least the blood sample
IC10: The presence of cycles  until the age of 40 years [AND] with proven fertility, at least one child
IC11: Amenorrhea and FSH> 30mUI/ml according to the criteria of the index subject
IC12: Men of the family of index case
IC15: Women who had regular cycles  until at least age 40 [AND] and at least one child
IC16: Lack of land autoimmune ([NOT] no history of thyroid disease [OR] or diabetes type 1)
IC17: Woman signing the consent form for at least the blood sample
